errors.name: Paused

errors.name: Authority

errors.name: Mint

errors.name: Alias

errors.name: Capacity

errors.name: Amount
errors.msg: Amount must be positive

errors.name: Reconciliation
errors.msg: Actual vault is below allocated cash or cash totals disagree

errors.name: Profile
errors.msg: Financial state is outside the implemented phase profile

errors.name: Domain
errors.msg: Domain identity must be nonzero

errors.name: MakerBinding
errors.msg: Maker program, config or capital binding mismatch

errors.name: MakerCapital
errors.msg: Maker capital is unfunded or outside the implemented profile

errors.name: MakerEpoch
errors.msg: Maker or market epoch mismatch or expired quote

errors.name: MakerQuarantined
errors.msg: Maker registration is quarantined

errors.name: MakerUpgrade
errors.msg: Maker deployment differs from approved ProgramData hash

errors.name: MakerQuote
errors.msg: Maker quote exceeds price, size or capacity bounds

errors.name: MakerResponse
errors.msg: Maker response producer, encoding or terms mismatch

errors.name: RouteIntent
errors.msg: Route authority, quantity, lifetime, nonce or generation mismatch

errors.name: RiskObservation
errors.msg: Synthetic observation is unavailable, stale or mismatched

errors.name: RouteLimit
errors.msg: Route exceeds all-in, fee or execution bounds

errors.name: RouteHealth
errors.msg: Post-fee health or exposure capacity fails

errors.name: ExitCohort
errors.msg: Exit cohort is incomplete, insolvent, foreign or stale

errors.name: FinancialSequence
errors.msg: Financial action is bound to a different market sequence

errors.name: OracleSource
errors.msg: Oracle source identity, verification or schema mismatch

errors.name: OraclePolicy
errors.msg: Oracle action mode, sample timing or source policy rejects action

errors.name: OrderState
errors.msg: Stored order identity, version, prefix or state mismatch

errors.name: OrderTerms
errors.msg: Order quantity, limits, lifetime, trigger or generation rejected

errors.name: OrderSlots
errors.msg: No free bounded order/protective-group slot

errors.name: OrderTrigger
errors.msg: Current central index does not satisfy stored trigger

errors.name: Liquidation
errors.msg: Liquidation receiver, funded fee or strict risk progress check failed

errors.name: Resolution
errors.msg: Resolution epoch, stage, cursor, cohort or accounting check failed

errors.name: FundingReport
errors.msg: Funding publisher authority, report binding, sequence or lifetime rejected

types.name: AccountCashSnapshot
docs: Version-3 custody payloads are scalar snapshots, never nested account types.

fields.name: kind
docs: 0 venue, 1 market, 2 portfolio, 3 margin, 4 deposit, 5 withdrawal,
6 cash transfer, 7 pause, 8 surplus classification, 9 reserve seed, 10 registry.

fields.name: kind
docs: 0 withdrawal, 1 transfer, 2 collection, 3 payment, 4 flat netting,
5 retained fees allocated to insurance, 6 retained fee token withdrawal.

types.name: AccountResolutionFrozen
docs: The complete frozen input header; wide derived work is emitted separately.

fields.name: outcome
docs: 1 rejected/reset; 2 exact prescribed clipping; 3 complete verified rates.

fields.name: kind
docs: 0 observe, 1 resolved->custody, 2 explicit candidate reactivation.

types.name: AccountTransition
docs: Final authenticated footer for one successful clearing invocation.

fields.name: revision
docs: Scoped journal revision; never a financial signing or risk parameter.

types.name: CurveControl
docs: Borsh discriminants 0..3, with no extra vector-length prefix on the payload.

docs: Scoped journal revision; never a financial signing or risk parameter.

docs: Canonical venue-registry indices, not a user-selected group membership.

fields.name: book
docs: Reuse only the stable scalar wire records; V2 handlers cannot own V3 bytes.

docs: Scoped journal revision; never a financial signing or risk parameter.

fields.name: revision
docs: Scoped journal revision; never a financial signing or risk parameter.

fields.name: insurance_fee_remainder
docs: Modulo-four fee-count carry, never collateral or a participant claim.

fields.name: liability_version
docs: Economic mutations of roots owing to this market invalidate its backing proof.

fields.name: level
docs: Zero points to member pages; 14 is the root for a u64 ID namespace.

fields.name: counts
docs: Number of Financial roots, not number of populated pages.

fields.name: status
docs: 0 no credible bounds, 1 degraded, 2 normal (subject to live clock checks).

fields.name: trigger
docs: 0 none, 1 central reference >= threshold, 2 <= threshold.

fields.name: revision
docs: Scoped journal revision; never a financial signing or risk parameter.

fields.name: index_initialized
docs: Qualification bridge only: immutable copies of the existing <=64 roots.

types.name: ProgramData
docs: Loader enum variant 3 followed by its fixed metadata prefix. Program code
remains trailing data and is authenticated in full by the maker hash check.

fields.name: revision
docs: Scoped journal revision; never a financial signing or risk parameter.

fields.name: rate_factor
docs: At most 186 bits; unused high six bits must be zero.

fields.name: revision
docs: Scoped journal revision; never a financial signing or risk parameter.

types.name: ResolutionRow
docs: Fixed scalar inputs are enough to reconstruct every terminal exact adjustment.

fields.name: exact_flow_numerators
docs: Magnitudes. Direction is determined by the original claim sign.

types.name: ResolutionWork
docs: Bounded continuation registers for arithmetic, proof scans and circulation.
P26 verifies every opcode/cursor; caller data is not a trusted payout plan.

fields.name: revision
docs: Scoped journal revision; never a financial signing or risk parameter.

fields.name: residual_capacity
docs: Original <=192 edges plus <=67 residual source/sink edges, both directions.

fields.name: market_edge_order
docs: Market forward-edge ordering is checked as a complete stable permutation.

types.name: RetirementCertificate
docs: Terminal administrative proof only. Ordinary owner exits never depend on
this complete-cohort scan or its global discovery-sequence stamp.

Revision is internal scratch progress, not a trader signing nonce.

fields.name: word_count
docs: Addressable words in this allocation's last page, otherwise 256.

fields.name: delegate_epoch
docs: Zero for owner-created authority, otherwise the root's delegate epoch.
